Hypothesis: folding U+00AD and U+2010-U+2015/U+2212 before matching, making ANY office vocabulary block confirmation (bare office(s) except home office, commut*, relocat*, HQ/headquarters, partially remote, work from home <n>, in person, onsite, hybrid), and accepting a title Remote label only when bracketed or followed by the end or a spaced separator, sends all 18 second-review rows out of the main catalog, keeps the existing 39 table rows unchanged, and leaves 0 office-vocabulary postings of the 100-job sample in the main catalog.
